notes.title: Update 0.4.1
notes.content:
Another big update, this one contains lots of requested features, QoL improvements and bugs that you guys have been reporting on our Discord!

[b]New Features / Content[/b]
[list]
[*] Ship designs can now be used even if they have more slots than you have unlocked through upgrades.
[*] Equipment panel now shows 'slot not unlocked' for slots on a ship you cannot use yet.
[*] Added the ability to reset slot selection on your ship for a cost in credits.
[/list]

[b]Balance Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Upgrades and slots can only be reset when you're at the mothership.
[*] Dodge cooldown increased from 0.25s to 1.0s.
[*] Mines now have less linear drag so they spread out further when deployed.
[/list]

[b]Quality of Life / Accessibility[/b]
[list]
[*] Players can now sell multiple items quickly using the new options at the bottom of the mothership panel.
[*] Sell confirmation message now includes how many credits you'll get.
[*] Pressing the quick jump binding at the mothership will jump you back to where you came from.
[*] Added quick jump location and details to navigation panel.
[*] Added new shortcut binding for controllers to quick jump on navigation panel.
[*] Smoothed out dodge dampening a bit at the end of dodge movements.
[*] Dodge cooldown is now displayed above ship bar on HUD.
[*] Added developer console button to pause menu, not available in demo.
[*] Equipment view to right side of mothership panel now includes locked slots.
[*] Grapple guns can now attach to mine projectiles.
[*] Hyperdrive jumping in and out of encounters no longer hides the HUD.
[*] Hyperdrive jump can now be cancelled while in countdown phase.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Game is now playabale on ultra-wide resolutions, although it looks a bit stretched on very wide splays.
[*] Reset to default no longer maxes our sandbox sector size slider.
[*] Fixed bug where grapple guns were not turning to aim like primary / secondary weapons.
[*] Fixed error from InputController when loading bindings in the menu.
[*] Fixed error when trying to clone Orchid in elite encounters.
[*] Fixed error when status effect destroys ship in the middle of hyperjumping out.
[*] Radar now shows correct enemy count when enemies attack the fleet.
[*] Quitting during the hand holding part of the tutroial will no longer save your game.
[*] Fixed bug where binding dodge to a specific key would not cap max velocity.
[*] Collecting a mission now correctly auto-tracks the next mission the player has.
[*] Collecting a mission no longer breaks controller navigation at the top of the panel.
[*] Slot display in upgrade panel now updates correctly when slot is unlocked via upgrade.
[*] Fixed some instances when swapping passive equipment would not work.
[*] Developer complete path tool will now complete mission requirements as well.
[*] Developer tools in navigation will no longer show up until player docks with mothership at Novus Prime.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.3.9
notes.content:
The difficulty system has been completely reworked. You can now choose your level of difficulty before you generate your sector. Enemy stats will be increased but so will your item / credit salvage.

[b]New Features / Content[/b]
[list]
[*] Removed old difficulty system entirely.
[*] Added new difficulty system with relaxed, normal, challenging, formidable, impossible and custom options.
[*] Added difficulty information to core panel navigation tab.
[*] Added difficulty icon to HUD radar.
[*] Added difficulty selection to sandbox setup.
[/list]

[b]Balance Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Only 25% of credits is now dropped on death, not cargo.
[*] Boosting no longer disables weapons as mechanic was frustrating.
[*] Average durability loss of 1 point per 5 seconds from a single item when taking hull damage.
[*] Black market items are now always your ships level (within constraints of sector level range)
[*] Black market items prices halved.
[*] Resistance and armor now caps at 80% for all ships.
[*] Behemoth now correctly has 5x the hull.

[*] Explosive egg launcher no longer drops below level 5.
[/list]

[b]Quality of Life / Accessibility[/b]
[list]
[*] DPS displayed on equipment now includes crit chance and crit damage.
[*] Sector size slider in sandbox now snaps to nearest 50 value.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Increased shield and hull of mothership and freighters.
[*] Repair cost of items now rounds up to nearest whole number.
[*] Typing non-numeric characters in discard / sell quantity no longer throws exceptions.
[*] Fixed issue where some dialog would not animate when playing with a controller.
[*] Fixed error when Vipers try to jump in warzone encounters.
[*] Complete encounters no longer show incorrect enemy count on radar.
[*] Fixed credit / item salvage showing each others values in equipment panel.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.3.8
notes.content:
Another update with a host of balance changes in response to people play testing our demo. Please continue giving us feedback on Discord as you test things out!

[b]New Features / Content[/b]
[list]
[*] Added version number to bottom right of HUD, setting added to Advanced to disable it.
[*] Items now permanently track the game version they came from and display it below their image.
[*] Piercing projectiles will now hit each enemy ship once regardless of size.
[/list]

[b]Equipment Buffs[/b]
[list]
[*] Cryo Gun, Plasmathrower and Flamethrower now have piercing projectiles.
[*] Torando Launcher missiles now snap to 3x their explosive radius on to enemy targets.
[*] Doubled angular drag of stalker / javelin missiles increasing their accuracy.
[*] Increased ROF of inferno cannon by 25%.
[*] Increased ROF of railgun by 25%.
[*] Point defense lasers now target closest valid target.
[*] Increased short / long range PDL damage by 25%.
[/list]

[b]Equipment Nerfs[/b]
[list]
[*] Different items no longer get a flat +25% increase in damage / duration / shield / etc.
[*] Rare items no longer get a flat +50% increase in damage / duration / shield / etc.
[*] Reduced scatter gun damage by 50%, velocity by 20% and heat generated increased 25%.
[*] Reduced plasma blaster damage by 50%.
[*] Reduced proton torpedo launcher ROF by 50%.
[*] Reduced javelin launcher ROF by 33%.
[*] Reduced stalker launcher ROF by 50%.
[*] Reduced stalker and javelin launcher projectile hull by 50%.
[*] Reduced caustic laser damage by 20%.
[*] Reduced freeze ray damage by 20%.
[*] Reduced heat ray damage by 20%.
[*] Reduced skeran laser damage by 20%.
[*] Reduced tesla coil damage by 20%.
[*] Reduced damage of Hornet Drones by 20%.
[*] Reduced damage of Roach Drones by 20%.
[/list]

[b]Quality of Life / Accessibility[/b]
[list]
[*] Added new Shortcuts category to assignable controls.
[*] Buttons in equipment panel can now have shortcut buttons assigned to them.
[*] Hyperjump button in navigation can now have a shortcut button assigned to it.
[*] Global modifiers button in equipment can now have a shortcut button assigned to it.
[*] Sandbox play button can now have a shortcut button assigned to it.
[*] Ship design finished button can now have a shortcut button assigned to it.
[*] Controller navigation up and down mission panel now makes more logical sense.
[*] Added controller bindings to backspace, shift and done in virtual keyboard.
[*] Disabled Steam keyboard in favour of the custom virtual keyboard in game.
[*] Controller navigation now locks to options when assigning consumables.
[*] Cargo space value now shows in red if cargo is full.
[*] Quantity of non-stackable items can no longer be modified for sell / discard.
[*] Inverted shift keys on virtual keyboard to match normal setup.
[*] Virtual keyboard when using non-Steam controllers now wraps navigation around edges.
[*] Renamed god mode status effect to invulnerability to match setting.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed exploit where you could sell more items than you had in a stack.
[*] Hunter (elite) should now only spawn trap with both you and it inside.
[*] Edges of cloud layer are no longer visible on higher camera distances.
[*] Credits no longer display max stack size when given as rewards.
[*] Custom sandbox ships are no longer invulnerable to damage.
[*] Sector Keystones no longer drop on death.
[*] Error handler no longer pops up on Warnings like controller connections.
[*] Scatter missiles that instantly explode no longer leave orphaned warning circles.
[*] Warzone waves will no longer exceed maximum waves if enemies are quickly destroyed.
[*] Hitting cancel / escape in the mission panel will now hide the level up banner.
[*] Dialog text animation should play for all text again.
[*] Text input fields no longer revert their value when cancel / escape hit.
[/list]ug Fixes
